linux.summary: amdgpu binds automatically and drives the internal panel at 4K and external displays out of the box.

caveats.summary: The internal panel runs at 3840x2160; native 5120x2880 is not enabled as shipped.
caveats.detail: Unlike the DCE 6.0 iMac17,1 (where 5K is bandwidth-impossible on one link), this Polaris GPU uses DisplayPort 1.4 / HBR3 and has the bandwidth for 5K60 on a single link, so 5K may be achievable. The reported machine ran 4K and did not pursue 5K, so it is recorded as a caveat, not a confirmed working mode.
